actual_scope: Actual13 distinct Refit help selections including9 revised messages, entry/exit and ordinary startup. All31 have independent controlled native coverage. Not31 ordinary visits, full-route playthrough or hardware verification.

records.english: Officers here recover their health and morale.
records.speaker: Ship component or crew-room help
records.context: Original Refit room/equipment explanation selected by stable COMMON ID. The original168x108 surface provides five body rows; heading and three detail rows occupy separate later rows. Spoken1256-1267 are excluded.
records.source_japanese:
ここにいる航海士は
体調や気分が回復します
records.source_meaning: The navigators here recover their physical condition and mood.
records.localization_note: Here refers to the selected room. Retain both physical recovery and mood recovery; morale is the existing help-family rendering of mood. Remove redundant location phrasing, not either effect.

records.english: A carpenter can repair damaged ships.
records.speaker: Ship component or crew-room help
records.context: Original Refit room/equipment explanation selected by stable COMMON ID. The original168x108 surface provides five body rows; heading and three detail rows occupy separate later rows. Spoken1256-1267 are excluded.
records.source_japanese:

船が傷んだときに
修理ができます
records.source_meaning: A ship carpenter allows repair when a ship is damaged.
records.localization_note: Retain: a carpenter enables repair of damaged ships. No repair rate, free repair or prevention of damage is promised.

records.english: A ship's doctor can cure ailments affecting officers and sailors.
records.speaker: Ship component or crew-room help
records.context: Original Refit room/equipment explanation selected by stable COMMON ID. The original168x108 surface provides five body rows; heading and three detail rows occupy separate later rows. Spoken1256-1267 are excluded.

航海士や水夫の体調異常を
治すことができます
records.source_meaning: A ship doctor can cure abnormal health conditions of navigators and sailors.
records.localization_note: The source says can cure, not merely treat. Ailments covers abnormal health conditions without restricting the explanation to disease or inventing named conditions.

records.english: A chief cook conserves food and water and makes sailors tire more slowly.
records.speaker: Ship component or crew-room help
records.context: Original Refit room/equipment explanation selected by stable COMMON ID. The original168x108 surface provides five body rows; heading and three detail rows occupy separate later rows. Spoken1256-1267 are excluded.
records.source_japanese:
料理長がいれば
水や食料の節約ができ
水夫も疲れにくくなります
records.source_meaning: A chief cook conserves water and food and makes sailors tire less easily.
records.localization_note: Preserve two separate benefits: conserving both resources and slowing sailor fatigue. More slowly is clearer than less quickly; no immediate fatigue recovery or causal connection between the two benefits is asserted.

records.english: Officers here recover their morale and make sailors tire more slowly.
records.speaker: Ship component or crew-room help
records.context: Original Refit room/equipment explanation selected by stable COMMON ID. The original168x108 surface provides five body rows; heading and three detail rows occupy separate later rows. Spoken1256-1267 are excluded.

records.localization_note: Preserve the officers versus sailors distinction and the separate mood and fatigue effects. Slower fatigue does not mean restored fatigue or complete prevention.

records.english: A purser lets you bargain and corner markets.
records.speaker: Ship component or crew-room help

records.english: A split sail improves square sail performance, increasing speed with a following wind.

records.context: Original Refit room/equipment explanation selected by stable COMMON ID. The original168x108 surface provides five body rows; heading and three detail rows occupy separate later rows. Spoken1256-1267 are excluded.
